title: Infernus CLI project files
description: One schema for the two JSON files that @infernus/cli keeps in a project root: infernus.json (the hand-editable manifest) and infernus-lock.json (the generated lockfile). The two branches are structurally disjoint, so oneOf is used and not anyOf: a manifest carries no lockfileVersion and stores each version as a string, while a lockfile requires a numeric lockfileVersion and nests one object per dependency. A document can therefore never satisfy both branches at once.

dependencyId.description: Dependency identifier in owner/repo form, e.g. openmultiplayer/open.mp, dockfries/samp-node or dockfries/samp-streamer-plugin.

manifestVersion.description: npm-style semver RANGE, or a literal release tag to pin one build, as accepted by the CLI's validRange() check (see utils/semver.ts). Examples: *, ^1.5.8, 1.6.7, ~2.9.6, >=1.0.0, v1.6.7.3218. This is what the user writes and is NOT the installed tag name.

lockVersion.description: Literal git tag name of the resolved GitHub release, written verbatim as matchedRelease.tag_name (see utils/dep.ts). Examples: v1.5.8.3079, v1.6.7.3218, 2.6.1, v2.9.6, v1-RC2. This is a tag, NOT a semver range.

manifest.title: infernus.json
manifest.description: The project dependency manifest, read from and written to process.cwd()/infernus.json (LocalConfig). Each key maps an owner/repo dependency to the semver range the CLI resolves against GitHub releases, whose concrete result is then recorded in infernus-lock.json.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to this schema; the CLI keeps this key when it rewrites the file, so it is allowed here.

dependencies.description: Declared dependencies keyed by owner/repo. Every value is a semver range to resolve; unknown dependency names are rejected by propertyNames.

additionalProperties.description: Semver range requested in the manifest (e.g. ^1.5.8), not the resolved tag name that appears in infernus-lock.json.

lockfile.title: infernus-lock.json
lockfile.description: The generated lockfile, read from and written to process.cwd()/infernus-lock.json (LockFileContent). It pins the exact release tag installed for each dependency; it is produced by the CLI, so it is not meant to be edited by hand.

lockfileVersion.description: Lockfile format version; the CLI currently writes 1.

dependencies.description: Resolved dependencies keyed by owner/repo, normally mirroring the keys declared in infernus.json.

lockfileDep.title: Locked dependency entry
lockfileDep.description: One resolved dependency (LockFileDep). version is always written; component is written for every dependency except open.mp itself. Unknown keys are rejected.

version.description: The installed release tag name (e.g. v1.5.8.3079 resolved from the manifest range ^1.5.8), stored literally so the dependency can be re-resolved from the global cache.

component.description: True when the dependency is installed as an open.mp component (components/), false when installed as a legacy plugin (plugins/), matching the CLI's --component flag.
